what_happened: Re-derived run-all.sh counts independently per dispatch instruction: BimodalLogic (the repro env for the external-source-store cause) now shows 37 of 174 suites failing (2 EXPECTED baseline, 35 NEW), not the originally-cited 26 of 156. Of the 35 NEW, only 6 of the originally-named 8 suites (test-askuserquestion-rehome.sh, test-deploy-propagation.sh, test-routing-resolution.sh, test-update-task-status.sh, test-lint-dead-command-recommendations.sh, test-manifest-scripts-sync.sh) are actually caused by the external-source-store condition -- confirmed by a hardcoded agent-system/extensions/* path with no .claude-extensions.json or deployed-tree fallback in each. The other 2 named suites (test-gate-cache-lib.sh, test-orchestrate-build-aux-dispatch.sh) fail identically in nvim too, which HAS a local agent-system/ -- so their failure is NOT the external-source-store cause; they are misattributed. The remaining ~29 NEW failures in BimodalLogic (10 of which also fail identically in nvim) form a separate, large, currently-live regression cluster around deploy/gate/orchestrate-postflight machinery, unrelated to source-store topology and out of this task's scope.

Carried-figure check refuted one description premise outright: the description asserts 'agent-system/ does not exist at this repository's root' as independently re-confirmed, but agent-system/extensions/core is present here with 147+9 suites and full git history. The research report already established this (nvim is the source-store OWNER and cannot reproduce the symptom locally); the plan is authored against the research's corrected framing, with the external-source-store condition reproduced by a synthetic fixture instead of by this repository's own topology.

run-all.sh has no exit-code SKIP protocol: its PASS/FAIL decision is binary on rc==0 (with 124/137 special-cased as timeout), and [SKIP] is reserved exclusively for a non-executable suite file. A suite cannot self-declare 'environmentally unrunnable, skipped with reason' today without a new reserved-exit-code contract in run-all.sh. This independently strengthens the research report's rejection of design option (b) and is recorded in the plan's Decisions so the implementer does not attempt a SKIP that would silently read as PASS.

suite_selection_select over each planned phase's Files-to-modify set produced every Tier Justification mechanically rather than by guesswork, and surfaced a real cost fact that reshaped the phase split: touching lib/common.sh selects ~157 suites (effectively the whole corpus) and deploy-root-guard.sh selects 59, so the two shared-choke-point edits were merged into ONE full-tier phase instead of paying two complete gate runs.
